title: service-quota.v1.AppliedQuotaList
description:
A `quota` object represents a quota configuration for a specific Confluent Cloud resource.
Use this API to retrieve an individual quota or list of quotas for a given scope.


Related guide: [Service Quotas for Confluent Cloud](https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/quotas/index.html).

<SchemaDefinition schemaRef="#/components/schemas/service-quota.v1.AppliedQuota" />

api_version.description: APIVersion defines the schema version of this representation of a resource.

kind.description: Kind defines the object this REST resource represents.

id.description: ID is the "natural identifier" for an object within its scope/namespace; it is normally unique across time but not space. That is, you can assume that the ID will not be reclaimed and reused after an object is deleted ("time"); however, it may collide with IDs for other object `kinds` or objects of the same `kind` within a different scope/namespace ("space").

scope.description: The applied scope that this quota belongs to.

display_name.description: A human-readable name for the quota type name.

applied_limit.description: The latest applied service quota value, taking into account any limit adjustments.

usage.description: Show the quota usage value if the quota usage is available for this quota.

user.description: The user associated with this object.

organization.description: A unique organization id to associate a specific organization to this quota.

environment.description: The environment ID the quota is associated with.

network.description: The network ID the quota is associated with.

kafka_cluster.description: The kafka cluster ID the quota is associated with.
